new_lines: // Calculate the mean based on the sample size, number of successes, and population size
// Added a check for division by zero to prevent ArithmeticException
// Method to calculate the numerical mean of the hypergeometric distribution

// Mutation 3: Changing division to multiplication
        return (double) (getSampleSize() * getNumberOfSuccesses()) * (double) getPopulationSize();

// Mutation 2: Adding 1 to getPopulationSize() to avoid division by zero
        return (double) (getSampleSize() * getNumberOfSuccesses()) / (double) (getPopulationSize() + 1);

// Mutation 4: Adding small epsilon value to avoid division by zero
        return (double) (getSampleSize() * getNumberOfSuccesses()) / (double) (getPopulationSize() + 1e-9);
